atlas:caudate.method: Centroid of CIT168 subcortical atlas (Pauli 2018), Lead-DBS import label 'Caudate nucleus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:cm.method: Centroid of Morel thalamus atlas in MNI space (Lead-DBS: 'Morel Atlas (Jakab 2008)') label 'Centromedian nucleus (CM)' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:dentate.method: Centroid of SUIT cerebellar atlas, dentate labels (Diedrichsen) label 'Dentate nucleus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:gpe.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'Globus pallidus externus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:gpi.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'Globus pallidus internus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:gpi_sm.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'GPi, sensorimotor zone' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:nacc.method: Centroid of CIT168 subcortical atlas (Pauli 2018), Lead-DBS import label 'Nucleus accumbens' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:pf.method: Centroid of Morel thalamus atlas in MNI space (Lead-DBS: 'Morel Atlas (Jakab 2008)') label 'Parafascicular nucleus (Pf)' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:psa.method: Centroid of Zona incerta atlas (Lau 2020) label 'Caudal zona incerta (PSA)' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:putamen.method: Centroid of CIT168 subcortical atlas (Pauli 2018), Lead-DBS import label 'Putamen' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:rn.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'Red nucleus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:snc.method: Centroid of CIT168 subcortical atlas (Pauli 2018), Lead-DBS import label 'Substantia nigra pars compacta' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:snr.method: Centroid of CIT168 subcortical atlas (Pauli 2018), Lead-DBS import label 'Substantia nigra pars reticulata' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:stn.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'Subthalamic nucleus' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:stn_assoc.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'STN, associative zone' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:stn_limbic.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'STN, limbic zone' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:stn_motor.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'STN, sensorimotor zone' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:vim.method: Centroid of DISTAL Medium (Ewert 2017) label 'Ventral intermediate nucleus (Vim)' (voxels >= 0.5).

atlas:vo.method: Centroid of Morel thalamus atlas in MNI space (Lead-DBS: 'Morel Atlas (Jakab 2008)') label 'Ventral oral complex (Vo)' (voxels >= 0.5).

ss_cerv.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (Dystonia Response Tract Atlas (Horn 2022), built on the Petersen 2019 pathway atlas).

ss_dyt.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (Human Dysfunctome Atlas (Hollunder 2024)).

ss_gen.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (Dystonia Response Tract Atlas (Horn 2022), built on the Petersen 2019 pathway atlas).

ss_pd.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (Human Dysfunctome Atlas (Hollunder 2024)).

ss_tremor.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (TOR-PSM probabilistic stimulation maps (Elias 2021)).

ss_ts.method: Value-weighted centroid of the connected region >= 50% of the positive maximum in the published map (Human Dysfunctome Atlas (Hollunder 2024)).
